complexity.notes: Clean, idiomatic Kadane's. Starting current at 0 works because the first iteration sets current = max(num, num); initializing current = nums[0] would be marginally clearer but this is fine. Time complexity is already optimal for this problem.
complexity.summary: Single pass over the array maintaining the best sum ending at the current position (either extending the running subarray or restarting at the current element), tracking the maximum seen overall.
